summary: Centerra Gold Inc. filed a Form 6-K with Condensed Consolidated Interim Financial Statements, MD&A, and CEO/CFO certifications for Q1 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report of a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16, not a special situation. It contains no event of acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, or management change. The 6-K serves to submit Canadian regulatory filings to the SEC as required; no deal terms or special corporate action are described.
